name: Migrate the Opal Capital website (WordPress) to AWS
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-01. Lift-and-shift the Opal Capital marketing website into the Opal AWS estate; keep GoDaddy as the DNS/registrar (records-only cutover, no zone move). GROUNDED against two provided backups (updraft backup.zip = UpdraftPlus set 2026-06-30; opalcapital.zip = full tree + 16MB opal_202606.sql): WordPress built with Bricks builder (bricks + bricks-opal child + AutomaticCSS); 16MB DB, ~13MB media, 18 plugins (gravityforms/omnisend/wp-mail-smtp/litespeed-cache/redirection/seopress/pdf-embedder/safe-svg/ACPT + security wps-hide-login/wps-limit-login/password-protected/turnstile + updraftplus/migrate-guru). Small low-traffic corporate site. TARGET (recommended): EC2 in the Opal VPC (Terraform-managed), OpenLiteSpeed+PHP8+MariaDB-local (16MB DB doesn't warrant RDS), Elastic IP (GoDaddy apex A-record -> EIP = the clean keep-GoDaddy path), Let's Encrypt/Certbot TLS, UpdraftPlus->S3 backups, SG-locked + SSM. Alternatives documented: Lightsail (simpler, off-VPC), EC2+RDS (overkill for 16MB), EC2+CloudFront+ACM (GoDaddy-apex-ALIAS nuance). Static-export REJECTED (Gravity Forms + dynamic backend). Migration: Terraform provision -> WP stack -> UpdraftPlus restore -> re-activate licenses (Bricks/ACSS/GravityForms/Omnisend) -> configure -> STAGE+CVO-verify -> lower TTL -> GoDaddy record cutover -> Certbot -> post-verify -> rollback-window (old host stays live). ~$20-40/mo. PRD docs/architecture/NFRA_WEBSITE_PRD.md.
phase: Phase 0: PRD complete (CTO 2026-07-01), grounded against the two backups + 3 house-style SVG diagrams rendered to Desktop (current/target/migration).
